text: This staff report is about a matter for which Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services, on behalf of Councillor Davis and area residents is requesting approval to prohibit westbound right turns at all times from the driveway of Toronto Honda automobile dealership (2300 Danforth Avenue) located on the east side of Gledhill Avenue, at a point 18 metres north of Danforth Avenue, and eastbound left turns from the driveways of Toronto Honda on the west side of Oak Park Avenue, at a point 11 metres and 28 metres north of Danforth Avenue. The implementation of the westbound right turn off onto Gledhill Avenue and eastbound left turn prohibition onto Oak Park Avenue from the driveways of Toronto Honda will address area residents concerns regarding excessive driver speeds and traffic infiltration caused by…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited westbound right turns at all times from the driveway of 2300 Danforth Avenue located on the east side of on Gledhill Avenue at a point 18 metres north of Danforth Avenue. 2. Prohibited eastbound left turns at all times from the driveway of 2300 Danforth Avenue located on the west side of on Oak Park Avenue at a point 11 metres north of Danforth Avenue, and at a point 28 metres north of Danforth Avenue.
